mapper.select: SELECT R.REQ_NO, R.EMP_NO, R.ATT_TYPE, R.REQ_DT, R.REASON FROM TB_ATT_REQ R JOIN TB_EMP E ON E.EMP_NO = R.EMP_NO WHERE E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{EMP_NM} || '%' AND R.ATT_TYPE = #{ATT_TYPE} ORDER BY R.REQ_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATT_REQ (REQ_NO, EMP_NO, ATT_TYPE, REQ_DT, REASON, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_ATT_REQ.NEXTVAL, #{EMP_NO}, #{ATT_TYPE}, #{REQ_DT}, #{REASON}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATT_REQ SET ATT_TYPE = #{ATT_TYPE}, REQ_DT = #{REQ_DT}, REASON = #{REASON} WHERE REQ_NO = #{REQ_NO}
UPDATE TB_ATT_REQ SET STATUS = 'REQ' WHERE REQ_NO = #{REQ_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATT_APPR (REQ_NO, APPR_STATUS, REQ_TM) VALUES (#{REQ_NO}, 'WAIT', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT A.REQ_NO, E.EMP_NM, R.ATT_TYPE, R.REQ_DT, A.APPR_STATUS FROM TB_ATT_APPR A JOIN TB_ATT_REQ R ON R.REQ_NO = A.REQ_NO JOIN TB_EMP E ON E.EMP_NO = R.EMP_NO WHERE A.APPR_STATUS = NVL(#{APPR_STATUS}, A.APPR_STATUS) AND E.DEPT_CD = NVL(#{DEPT_CD}, E.DEPT_CD)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATT_APPR SET APPR_STATUS = 'OK', APPR_TM = SYSDATE WHERE REQ_NO = #{REQ_NO}
UPDATE TB_ATT_APPR SET APPR_STATUS = 'NO', APPR_TM = SYSDATE WHERE REQ_NO = #{REQ_NO}
